questions.question: How do I become a member?
questions.answer: Open Join the Library, fill in the short form and submit it. Library staff review each application and you will be told when it is approved. You can also create an account yourself from the Sign in page.

questions.question: How do I borrow a book?
questions.answer: Find a title in the catalog and open its details. Sign in to reserve it, then arrange collection with library staff. Staff issue a specific physical copy and record its due date.

questions.question: Does a reservation guarantee immediate collection?
questions.answer: A reservation joins the queue for a title. When a copy is free, the first reader in the queue is told it is ready. Track your reservations in your member portal.

questions.question: What is the difference between saving and reserving?
questions.answer: Saving adds a title to your personal reading list. It does not reserve a copy. Reserving records a request to borrow a title when a copy is available for you.

questions.question: Can I renew a loan?
questions.answer: Open My Books in your member portal and select Renew. A loan cannot be renewed if it is overdue, has reached the renewal limit, or has a waiting reservation.

questions.question: How do I return a book or cancel a request?
questions.answer: Return physical copies to library staff so they can record the return. To cancel a reservation, open Reservations in your member portal and select Cancel.

questions.question: What happens if a book is overdue?
questions.answer: Overdue loans appear in your account. Please return the books or speak to library staff. New borrowing is blocked while you have overdue loans, and a fine may apply if the library has set one.

questions.question: Where can I see updates about my loans?
questions.answer: Open Notifications in your member portal for borrowing and reservation updates. With a verified email address, the library can also send reminders when email delivery is enabled.
